# Pixel Scoreboard

A pixel-styled scoreboard for two teams. Track scores with +1, +2, and +3 buttons, undo the last score change, advance a period counter from 1 to 4, and reset the game.

## Features

- Two teams (Team A and Team B) with independent scores
- +1, +2, +3 scoring buttons per team
- Undo button reverts the last score change (including period changes)
- Period counter with increment/decrement, clamped between 1 and 4
- Reset game restores scores to 0, period to 1, and clears undo history
- Fully keyboard accessible with visible focus states
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Offline: no external assets, imports, or network requests

## Controls

| Action | Control |
|--------|---------|
| Add points | +1 / +2 / +3 buttons under each team |
| Undo last change | Undo button (disabled when no history) |
| Change period | − / + buttons next to period value |
| Reset game | Reset Game button |

## Running

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Files

- `index.html` – structure and controls
- `style.css` – pixel theme, layout, responsive rules
- `app.js` – game state, undo stack, rendering
